#@path: src/core/near_miss/near_miss_core.gd
extends RefCounted

var a: Area3D
var b: CollisionObject3D
var c: CharacterBody3D
var d: RayCast3D
var e: ShapeCast3D
var f: RandomNumberGenerator


func _process(delta: float) -> void:
	randi()
	randf_range(0.0, 1.0)
	randomize()
	seed(1)
	Input.get_vector(&"a", &"b", &"c", &"d")
	Engine.get_frames_drawn()
	Time.get_ticks_usec()
	OS.get_name()
	DisplayServer.window_get_size()
	get_tree()
	PhysicsServer3D.area_create()
	var z: float = node.global_position.z + node.position.z
	var o = node.global_transform.origin
